source_context_review: Right-only lane must be a single designed right lane; commanded right turn does not prove actual turn or lane-use purpose.

statutory_branch_review.activation: A highway designed to provide a single right lane used only for turning, and the subject vehicle is driven in that lane.
statutory_branch_review.obligation: Use of that right turn lane is only for the purpose of making a right turn.
statutory_branch_review.timing: Observe occupancy before subsequent movement and retain a completed exit; authored command and measured movement are distinct.
statutory_branch_review.unresolved_judgment: Private purpose cannot be proved solely by the observed subsequent movement; the turn or straight continuation is an observable proxy requiring independent judgment.
statutory_branch_review.related_distinct_clause: NRS 484B.223(4)(b) separately prohibits traveling through an intersection while in the right turn lane.
statutory_branch_review.same_cell_issue: The frozen C382355 cell has maneuver right_turn, while controlled_2 requests straight continuation. The straight diagnostic has not been accepted as a valid selected case in this cell.
statutory_branch_review.unverified_fact: An authored right-turn arrow and lane topology do not establish a Native single right-only lane design; connector IDs and designation require original Native map and pixels.
